operating_notes.text: Hindustan Foods commenced commercial production of ice-creams at Panipat, Haryana.
Hindustan Foods commenced commercial operations at its third ice cream manufacturing facility in Panipat, Haryana.
Monitoring Agency Report notes ₹321.58 crore utilized out of ₹374.00 crore net proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Hindustan Foods consolidated FY26 revenue reached ₹4,251.04 Cr with a net profit of ₹149.03 Cr.
Paid-up share capital increased to ₹24.23 Cr consisting of 12,11,62,702 equity shares following the scheme of arrangement.
Hindustan Foods reported FY26 revenue of ₹4,265 Cr and PAT of ₹149 Cr, signing record project wins of ₹780 Cr.
Gross block including capital work in progress and capital advances reached more than ₹1,800 crores by March 2026.
V.S. Dempo Holdings holds 10.65% (1,28,99,157 shares) post-allotment under the scheme of arrangement.
Gross block including CWIP and capital advances reached ₹1,800 crore as of March 2026.
Received a GST demand order of ₹0.20 Cr for FY21-22 from Commercial Taxes Department, Tindivanam.
Project pipeline of ₹1,000 Cr with ₹500 Cr already signed for FY27
Footwear business employee cost is 35-40% of total employee cost
Silvassa facility partially restored, expected to be fully operational by end of August
Received ₹0.17 Cr GST demand order for FY 2022-23 from Tamil Nadu Commercial Taxes Department.

timeline.summary: Hindustan Foods commenced commercial production of ice-creams at Panipat, Haryana on April 30, 2026.
Hindustan Foods commenced commercial operations at its Panipat ice cream manufacturing facility on April 30, 2026.
Hindustan Foods filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 issued by CARE Ratings, showing ₹321.58 crore utilized from preferential issue proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,116.75 Cr, net profit ₹41.55 Cr.
Hindustan Foods allotted 4,81,39,085 equity shares pursuant to the NCLT-sanctioned scheme of arrangement, increasing paid-up capital to ₹24.23 crore.
Hindustan Foods released its Earnings Presentation for Q4 and FY26 on May 21, 2026, reporting record revenue of ₹4,265 crore and reiterating FY27 PAT guidance of ₹200-220 crore.
Hindustan Foods reported FY26 total income of ₹4,264.7 crore with a net profit of ₹149.0 crore and announced ₹100 crore in new capex approvals.
Dempo Group disclosed acquisition aggregate stake in Hindustan Foods via scheme of arrangement allotment under SAST Reg 10.
Hindustan Foods Limited’s Senior Management held an Analyst/Investors conference call on May 22, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance with an interactive Q&A session.
Hindustan Foods hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting revenue of ₹4,264 Cr and reiterating FY27 PAT guidance of ₹200-220 Cr.
Hindustan Foods received a ₹0.20 Cr GST demand order for FY22 from Commercial Taxes Department, Tindivanam on May 29, 2026.
Hindustan Foods held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 5, 2026, reporting 33% YoY PAT growth to ₹42.8 Cr and reaffirming FY27 guidance.
Hindustan Foods received a ₹0.17 Cr GST demand order for FY22-23 from the Tamil Nadu Commercial Taxes Department.
